=== How are parameter converted to types ===

You can use custom types in your [StepMethod step method] parameters.

Like [http://fitnesse.org/FitNesse.UserGuide.SliM SliM] the step executor will use a [http://java.sun.com/j2se/1.5.0/docs/api/java/beans/PropertyEditor.html PropertyEditor].

By default [http://java.sun.com/j2se/1.5.0/docs/api/java/beans/PropertyEditor.html property editors] can be in the same package as the object type or in the {{{bdd.parse}}} package.
